decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir sits close to the firm's core hydraulic steel engineering, so the development investment it embodies and its fit with established customer projects make persistence likely despite only a brief web mention.

The energy management system is central to the firm's announced direction of digital networking and energy recovery, so dropping it would contradict that public strategy, and early weak uptake can still be blamed on long municipal procurement cycles.

The overflow flap gate has a dedicated web page that signals visible public commitment and builds on proven core products, so management will keep it to protect the investment and the credibility of the launch.
